name: LiveKit
blurb: Contributions focused on test reliability and the developer experience in livekit/agents.
focus: Improving hermetic unit tests, making optional plugin and environment side effects explicit, and documenting contributor workflows.

items.title: tests: preserve shell environment when loading dotenv
items.contribution: Preserve shell environment when loading dotenv in TTS and realtime tests
items.detail: Removed override=True from load_dotenv() in test_tts.py and test_realtime.py so a discovered .env cannot overwrite variables already set in the shell. Aligns with the pattern already used in test_stt.py. Fixes discussion in issue #8230.

items.title: tests: discuss removing dotenv environment mutation during TTS collection
items.contribution: Discuss removing dotenv environment mutation during TTS test collection
items.detail: Opened after auditing import-time side effects following #8134. Reports that test_tts.py called load_dotenv(override=True) at module scope, which can replace intentional process environment values during collection. Proposes making dotenv preparation explicit without changing production behavior.

items.title: test: separate NLTK coverage from hermetic tokenizer unit tests
items.contribution: Separate NLTK coverage from hermetic tokenizer unit tests
items.detail: Core tokenizer unit tests imported the optional NLTK plugin and could trigger a Punkt model download during collection. Moved NLTK batch and streaming coverage into dedicated plugin tests, prepared model data in an explicit fixture, shared the corpus through a dependency-free module, and updated CI and contributor docs. Verified 63 core tokenizer tests with networking blocked and NLTK imports disabled; both NLTK plugin tests passed; formatting, lint, and type checks passed.
